change_summary: Separate selected local-source upload consent from evidence-based Skill and Memory admission while preserving explicit opt-out, Team scope, edit-signal, receipt, and rollback boundaries.

canonical_skill.note: The import Skill now separates source upload authority from ordinary evidence-based knowledge admission and keeps explicit opt-out and scope boundaries.

server_contract.note: The server advertises Skill and Plugin release 1.7.81 while collaboration protocol revision 2026-09-18.6 remains compatible.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin versions advance together because the public package includes the changed local-import Skill.

workspace_cli.note: The CLI transport and command contract are unchanged by this Skill guidance update.

help_center.note: Existing public Help remains compatible; the changed boundary is carried in the installable import Skill.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the synchronized 1.7.81 package version without changing the collaboration protocol revision.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records why upload consent and knowledge admission remain separate evidence decisions.

external_marketplaces.note: External marketplace review remains account-owned and is not implied by first-party publication.

public_release_assets.note: The canonical exporter regenerates the Skill and Plugin archives from the reviewed source and synchronized manifests.

release_evidence.note: Contract and package tests verify the new release version while preserving the existing protocol revision and authority boundaries.
